narrative.intro: Bechtel Plant Machinery has $2.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bechtel Plant Machinery has 8 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $259M. Obligations are down 3.6% year over year. Current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and all figures shown are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Historical obligations show a multiyear pattern: FY21 recorded $2B, FY22 recorded $2.1B, FY23 recorded $1.4B, FY24 recorded $2.2B, FY25 recorded $2.1B, and FY26 recorded $2.1B. The current fiscal-year position reflects similar absolute scale to the prior two years but a small year-over-year decline. Contractors and procurement analysts looking at Bechtel Plant Machinery should focus on award count, award size, and the fiscal-year comparables above when assessing program continuity and near-term capture opportunities.
